WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        f."Charter Funding Type" AS funding_category,
        1 AS school_count,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
        f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_eligible_pct,
        ssc.AvgScrRead + ssc.AvgScrMath + ssc.AvgScrWrite AS combined_sat_score
    FROM frpm f
    INNER JOIN schools sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode AND sc.StatusType = 'Active' AND sc.Charter = 1
    LEFT JOIN satscores ssc ON f.CDSCode = ssc.cds AND ssc.rtype = 'S'
    WHERE
        f."Academic Year" = '2014-15'
        AND f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        funding_category,
        COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
        SUM(COALESCE(enrollment,0)) AS total_enrollment,
        ROUND(AVG(frpm_eligible_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_pct,
        ROUND(AVG(combined_sat_score), 2) AS avg_combined_sat_score
    FROM base
    GROUP BY funding_category
)
SELECT
    funding_category,
    num_schools,
    total_enrollment,
    avg_frpm_eligible_pct,
    avg_combined_sat_score
FROM agg
ORDER BY funding_category
LIMIT 1000

WITH state_special_schools AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    School,
    GSserved
  FROM schools
  WHERE State = 'CA'
    AND DOCType = 'State Special'
    AND StatusType = 'Active'
    AND GSserved IS NOT NULL AND GSserved != ''
),
school_lowest_grade AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    School,
    GSserved,
    -- Extracts text before hyphen, trims spaces
    TRIM(LOWER(
      CASE
        WHEN instr(GSserved, '-') > 0 THEN substr(GSserved, 1, instr(GSserved, '-')-1)
        ELSE GSserved
      END
    )) AS lowest_grade_code
  FROM state_special_schools
),
grade_order AS (
  SELECT 'p' AS code, 0 AS gorder UNION ALL
  SELECT 'k', 1 UNION ALL
  SELECT '1', 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT '2', 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT '3', 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT '4', 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT '5', 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT '6', 7 UNION ALL
  SELECT '7', 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT '8', 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT '9', 10 UNION ALL
  SELECT '10', 11 UNION ALL
  SELECT '11', 12 UNION ALL
  SELECT '12', 13
),
school_grade_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.GSserved,
    s.lowest_grade_code,
    g.gorder AS lowest_grade_order
  FROM school_lowest_grade s
  LEFT JOIN grade_order g ON g.code = s.lowest_grade_code
),
sat_2014 AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    SUM(NumTstTakr) AS NumTstTakr
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'S'
    AND substr(cds,1,2) = '19' -- CA CDS code (could omit)
    AND (satscores.sname IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY cds
),
merged AS (
  SELECT
    sgr.CDSCode,
    sgr.School,
    sgr.GSserved,
    sgr.lowest_grade_order,
    sgr.lowest_grade_code,
    COALESCE(sat_2014.NumTstTakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers
  FROM school_grade_ranked sgr
  LEFT JOIN sat_2014 ON sat_2014.cds = sgr.CDSCode
)
SELECT
  School AS school_name,
  UPPER(lowest_grade_code) AS earliest_grade_level,
  NULL AS k12_enrollment, -- True K-12 enrollment not available in schema
  sat_test_takers
FROM merged
WHERE lowest_grade_order IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lowest_grade_order DESC, k12_enrollment DESC, school_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

treatment.sql:
WITH state_special_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        CDSCode, 
        School,
        COALESCE(GSserved, GSoffered) AS Grades
    FROM schools
    WHERE State = 'CA' 
      AND DOCType = 'Special'
      AND FundingType = 'State'
      AND StatusType = 'Active'
      AND (
          School LIKE '%Deaf%' OR School LIKE '%Blind%' OR School LIKE '%Special%' OR School LIKE '%State%' OR EdOpsName LIKE '%Special%' OR EdOpsName LIKE '%State%'
      )
      AND (COALESCE(GSserved, GSoffered) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(GSserved, GSoffered) != '')
),
parsed_grades AS (
    SELECT 
        CDSCode,
        School,
        Grades,
        CASE 
            WHEN instr(Grades, '-') > 0 THEN substr(Grades, 1, instr(Grades, '-') - 1)
            ELSE Grades
        END as StartGrade
    FROM state_special_schools
), grade_ordering AS (
    SELECT 'P' AS code, 1 AS ord UNION ALL
    SELECT 'K', 2 UNION ALL
    SELECT '1', 3 UNION ALL
    SELECT '2', 4 UNION ALL
    SELECT '3', 5 UNION ALL
    SELECT '4', 6 UNION ALL
    SELECT '5', 7 UNION ALL
    SELECT '6', 8 UNION ALL
    SELECT '7', 9 UNION ALL
    SELECT '8', 10 UNION ALL
    SELECT '9', 11 UNION ALL
    SELECT '10', 12 UNION ALL
    SELECT '11', 13 UNION ALL
    SELECT '12', 14
),
k12_enrollment AS (
    SELECT
        p.CDSCode,
        p.School,
        p.StartGrade,
        g.ord AS StartGradeOrder
    FROM parsed_grades p
    LEFT JOIN grade_ordering g ON g.code = p.StartGrade
),
k12_with_counts AS (
    SELECT
        k.CDSCode,
        k.School,
        k.StartGrade,
        k.StartGradeOrder,
        IFNULL(f.[Enrollment (K-12)], 0) AS K12Enrollment
    FROM k12_enrollment k
    LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = k.CDSCode AND f.[Academic Year] = '2014-15'
),
satscore_by_school AS (
    SELECT 
        cds, 
        SUM(NumTstTakr) AS SATTestTakers
    FROM satscores
    WHERE rtype = 'S'
    GROUP BY cds
),
with_sat AS (
    SELECT 
        k.CDSCode, 
        k.School,
        k.StartGrade,
        k.StartGradeOrder,
        k.K12Enrollment,
        IFNULL(ss.SATTestTakers, 0) AS SATTestTakers
    FROM k12_with_counts k
    LEFT JOIN satscore_by_school ss ON ss.cds = k.CDSCode
)
SELECT 
    School AS school_name,
    StartGrade AS earliest_grade,
    K12Enrollment AS k12_enrollment,
    SATTestTakers AS sat_test_takers
FROM with_sat
WHERE StartGradeOrder IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY StartGradeOrder DESC, K12Enrollment DESC, school_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

  JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = s.code
  GROUP BY s.code, s.name
)
SELECT
  set_name,
  CASE
    WHEN total_with_mana_cost > 0 THEN ROUND(cheap_count * 100.0 / total_with_mana_cost, 2)

  SELECT
    c.scryfallOracleId AS oracle_id,
    fd.name AS japanese_name,
    c.type AS english_card_type
  FROM cards c
  JOIN foreign_data fd
    ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
  WHERE
    c.watermark = 'boros'
    AND fd.language = 'Japanese'
),
typecard_map AS (
  -- Group together oracle_ids by exact (Japanese name, English type) key
  SELECT
    japanese_name,

  JOIN cards c

),
typecard_rulings AS (

  SELECT
    oap.japanese_name,

    WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
),

    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),

    FROM disp
    WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
),

    SELECT ao.account_id, c.district_id AS owner_district_id

    JOIN client c ON ao.client_id = c.client_id
),
owner_district_pop AS (
    SELECT od.account_id, od.owner_district_id, d.A2 AS owner_home_district, d.A3 AS owner_home_region, d.A8 AS district_population
    FROM owner_district od
    JOIN district d ON od.owner_district_id = d.district_id
),
external_counterparties AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS counterparties
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.type = 'TRANSFER' AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.bank) != ''
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT 
    p.account_id,
    p.date AS account_opened,
    COALESCE(l.total_borrowed,0) AS total_borrowed,
    COALESCE(ec.counterparties,0) AS num_counterparties,
    odp.owner_home_district,
    odp.district_population,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY odp.district_population DESC, p.account_id ASC) AS pop_rank
FROM 
    prachatice_branch p
    JOIN loans l ON p.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN owner_district_pop odp ON p.account_id = odp.account_id
    LEFT JOIN external_counterparties ec ON p.account_id = ec.account_id
ORDER BY pop_rank, p.account_id
LIMIT 1000

withdrawals_by_district AS (

  LEFT JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id
),
accounts_per_district AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
  FROM qualifying_districts d
  JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id
),
standing_debits_per_district AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, SUM(CASE WHEN o.k_symbol = 'SIPO' OR o.k_symbol = 'LEASING' OR o.k_symbol = 'INSURANCE' OR o.k_symbol = 'HOUSEHOLD' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS standing_order_total
  FROM qualifying_districts d
  JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  LEFT JOIN "order" o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id
),
final AS (
  SELECT 
    q.district_name, 
    q.region, 
    q.population, 
    wb.total_withdrawn, 
    ROUND(CAST(wb.total_withdrawn AS REAL)/q.population, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,

  JOIN withdrawals_by_district wb ON q.district_id = wb.district_id
  JOIN accounts_per_district apd ON q.district_id = apd.district_id
  LEFT JOIN standing_debits_per_district sd ON q.district_id = sd.district_id
)

  district_name,

WITH loans24 AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.date AS approval_date
    FROM loan l
    INNER JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24 AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY amount DESC, approval_date ASC
    ) AS rn
    FROM loans24
),
top10_loans AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked_loans WHERE rn <= 10
),
last_balances AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.date, 
           t.balance, t.trans_id
    FROM trans t
    INNER JOIN top10_loans l ON t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date = l.approval_date
),
last_balance_per_loan AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, lb.balance
    FROM top10_loans l
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT account_id, date, MAX(trans_id) AS max_tid
        FROM last_balances
        GROUP BY account_id, date
    ) x ON l.account_id = x.account_id AND l.approval_date = x.date
    INNER JOIN last_balances lb ON x.account_id = lb.account_id AND x.date = lb.date AND x.max_tid = lb.trans_id
),
loan_districts AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, d.A2 AS district
    FROM loan l
    INNER JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE l.loan_id IN (SELECT loan_id FROM top10_loans)
)
SELECT ld.district, t10.amount, t10.approval_date, lbpl.balance AS account_balance_eod
FROM top10_loans t10
INNER JOIN last_balance_per_loan lbpl ON t10.loan_id = lbpl.loan_id
INNER JOIN loan_districts ld ON t10.loan_id = ld.loan_id
ORDER BY t10.amount DESC, t10.approval_date ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH female_loans AS (
  SELECT l.*, d.client_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND l.status IN ('A','C','D')
),
ranked_loans AS (
  SELECT *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rnk
  FROM female_loans
  WHERE status = 'A'
),
top_loans AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked_loans WHERE rnk <= 3
),
total_deposits AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS deposits, 
         COUNT(*) AS trans_count
    FROM trans
   GROUP BY account_id
),
account_district AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, dist.A3 AS district, dist.A2 AS region
  FROM account a
  JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
),
region_loan_counts AS (
  SELECT ad.region, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loans_in_region
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
  JOIN account_district ad ON a.account_id = ad.account_id
  GROUP BY ad.region
),
region_avg_salary AS (
  SELECT d.A2 AS region, ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS region_avg_salary
  FROM district d
  GROUP BY d.A2
)
SELECT
  t.loan_id,
  t.client_id,
  ROUND(t.amount, 2) AS loan_amount,
  t.duration AS duration_months,
  ROUND(t.payments * t.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
  ROUND(t.payments * t.duration - t.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
  t.status AS loan_status,
  ad.district,
  ad.region,
  td.trans_count,
  ROUND(td.deposits, 2) AS total_deposits,
  CASE 
     WHEN td.deposits > 2*t.amount THEN 'High Income'
     WHEN td.deposits > t.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
     ELSE 'Low Income' 
  END AS income_category,
  rlc.loans_in_region,
  ras.region_avg_salary,
  (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
     - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date))) AS age_on_date
FROM top_loans t
JOIN client c ON t.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account_district ad ON t.account_id = ad.account_id
LEFT JOIN total_deposits td ON t.account_id = td.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_loan_counts rlc ON ad.region = rlc.region
LEFT JOIN region_avg_salary ras ON ad.region = ras.region
ORDER BY t.amount DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH female_clients AS (

  FROM client c
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
female_loan_accounts AS (

ranked_loans AS (

),
top_loans AS (

),
loan_clients AS (
  SELECT tl.*, fc.birth_date, fc.district_id as client_district_id
  FROM top_loans tl
  JOIN female_clients fc ON tl.client_id = fc.client_id
),
account_info AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id AS account_district_id
  FROM account a
),
account_district AS (
  SELECT ai.account_id, ai.account_district_id, d.A2 as district_name, d.A3 as region, d.A11 as avg_salary
  FROM account_info ai
  JOIN district d ON ai.account_district_id = d.district_id
),
loan_with_region AS (
  SELECT lc.*, ad.district_name, ad.account_district_id, ad.avg_salary, ad.region as branch_region
  FROM loan_clients lc
  JOIN account_district ad ON lc.account_id = ad.account_id
),
region_loan_counts AS (
  SELECT d.A3 as region, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS region_loans
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
avg_salaries AS (
  SELECT d.A3 as region, ROUND(AVG(d.A11),2) AS region_avg_salary
  FROM district d
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
account_trans AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, 
         COUNT(*) AS trans_count, 
         ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS total_deposits
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
enriched AS (
  SELECT lwr.loan_id, lwr.client_id, lwr.amount, lwr.duration, lwr.payments, lwr.status,
         lwr.district_name, lwr.branch_region, at.trans_count, at.total_deposits, 
         CASE
           WHEN at.total_deposits > lwr.amount*2 THEN 'High Income'
           WHEN at.total_deposits > lwr.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
           ELSE 'Low Income'
         END AS income_category,
         rlc.region_loans, asal.region_avg_salary,
         lwr.birth_date,
         lwr.date AS loan_date
  FROM loan_with_region lwr
  LEFT JOIN account_trans at ON lwr.account_id = at.account_id
  LEFT JOIN region_loan_counts rlc ON lwr.branch_region = rlc.region
  LEFT JOIN avg_salaries asal ON lwr.branch_region = asal.region
),
age_calc AS (
  SELECT *, 
         CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)
         - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date)) AS completed_age
  FROM enriched
)
SELECT loan_id, client_id, 
       ROUND(amount,2) AS amount, 
       duration, 
       ROUND(duration*payments,2) AS total_payments, 
       ROUND(duration*payments - amount,2) AS interest_paid, 
       status, district_name, branch_region AS region, trans_count, total_deposits, 
       income_category, region_loans, region_avg_salary,
       completed_age
FROM age_calc
ORDER BY amount DESC, loan_id
LIMIT 1000

WITH gold_card_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
district_info AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 as district_name, A3 as region_name
    FROM district
),
loans_per_account AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
trans_summary AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL THEN (t.bank || '-' || COALESCE(CAST(t.account AS TEXT),'')) END) AS num_external_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT 
    g.account_id,
    d.district_name,
    d.region_name,
    COALESCE(ts.amount_received,0) AS total_amount_received,
    COALESCE(ts.amount_withdrawn,0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(l.num_loans,0) AS num_loans,
    COALESCE(ts.num_external_counterparties,0) AS num_external_counterparties,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ts.num_external_counterparties,0) DESC) as external_counterparty_rank
FROM gold_card_accounts g
LEFT JOIN district_info d ON g.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN loans_per_account l ON g.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_summary ts ON g.account_id = ts.account_id
ORDER BY external_counterparty_rank, g.account_id
LIMIT 1000

WITH gold_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
account_external AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
      WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank != '' THEN t.bank || ':' || t.account 
      ELSE NULL END) AS num_external_counterparties
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accounts)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_loans
  FROM loan l
  WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accounts)
  GROUP BY l.account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT 
    ga.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    COALESCE(ae.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
    COALESCE(ae.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(lc.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
    COALESCE(ae.num_external_counterparties, 0) AS num_external_counterparties
  FROM gold_accounts ga
  JOIN district d ON ga.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN account_external ae ON ga.account_id = ae.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_counts lc ON ga.account_id = lc.account_id
)
SELECT *,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.num_external_counterparties)
   FROM base b
   WHERE b.num_external_counterparties > base.num_external_counterparties) + 1 AS rank
FROM base
ORDER BY num_external_counterparties DESC, account_id

    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
),
owner_disp AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, d.client_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
owner_profile AS (
    SELECT ta.account_id, ta.open_date, c.gender, 
           CAST((strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS INTEGER) AS owner_age
    FROM tabor_accounts ta
    JOIN owner_disp od ON ta.account_id = od.account_id
    JOIN client c ON od.client_id = c.client_id
),
cards_pre1997 AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_cards
    FROM card ca
    JOIN disp d ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE ca.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loans_pre1997 AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_default,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status IN ('C','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_repaying,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_paid
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_labels AS (
    SELECT ta.account_id,
           CASE 
             WHEN lp.account_id IS NULL THEN 'no loan'
             WHEN lp.has_default = 1 THEN 'defaulted'
             WHEN lp.has_repaying = 1 THEN 'repaying'
             WHEN lp.has_paid = 1 THEN 'paid off'
             ELSE 'paid off'
           END AS loan_label,
           COALESCE(lp.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans
    FROM tabor_accounts ta
    LEFT JOIN loans_pre1997 lp ON ta.account_id = lp.account_id
),
trans_1997 AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_trans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'withdrawal') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
           MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
with_all_fields AS (
    SELECT op.account_id, op.open_date, op.gender, op.owner_age,
           COALESCE(cp.num_cards, 0) AS num_cards,
           ll.num_loans,
           ll.loan_label,
           COALESCE(t97.num_trans, 0) AS num_trans,
           COALESCE(t97.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
           COALESCE(t97.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
           COALESCE(t97.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM owner_profile op
    LEFT JOIN cards_pre1997 cp ON op.account_id = cp.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_labels ll ON op.account_id = ll.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trans_1997 t97 ON op.account_id = t97.account_id
)
SELECT *,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC, account_id ASC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM with_all_fields
ORDER BY peak_balance DESC, account_id ASC
LIMIT 1000

WITH tabor_branch AS (
  SELECT d.district_id
  FROM district d
  WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor' -- Name field, district match
),
accounts_in_tabor AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date AS open_date
  FROM account a
  INNER JOIN tabor_branch t ON a.district_id = t.district_id
),
account_owner AS (
  SELECT disp.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
  FROM disp
  JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
owners_at_1996 AS (
  SELECT ao.account_id, ao.gender,
         -- Calculate whole years completed as age at 1996-12-31
         CAST((julianday('1996-12-31') - julianday(ao.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age_at_1996
  FROM account_owner ao
),
cards_by_96 AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(card.card_id) AS num_cards
  FROM accounts_in_tabor a
  LEFT JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
  LEFT JOIN card ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id AND card.issued <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY a.account_id
),
loans_by_96 AS (
  SELECT a.account_id,
         COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_loans,
         -- Standing labels: no loan, defaulted, repaying, paid off
         CASE WHEN COUNT(l.loan_id) = 0 THEN 'no loan'
              WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'defaulted'
              WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'repaying'
              ELSE 'paid off' END AS loan_status
  FROM accounts_in_tabor a
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id AND l.date <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY a.account_id
),
trans_1997 AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         COUNT(t.trans_id) AS num_trans_1997,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in_1997,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('debit', 'withdrawal') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out_1997,
         COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN t.balance IS NOT NULL THEN t.balance ELSE NULL END), 0) AS peak_balance_1997
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
peak_balances AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, COALESCE(t97.peak_balance_1997, 0) AS peak_balance_1997
  FROM accounts_in_tabor a
  LEFT JOIN trans_1997 t97 ON a.account_id = t97.account_id
),
ranked_accounts AS (
  SELECT account_id, peak_balance_1997, 
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance_1997 DESC, account_id ASC) AS peak_balance_rank
  FROM peak_balances
)
SELECT 
  a.account_id, 
  a.open_date, 
  o.gender, 
  o.age_at_1996, 
  c.num_cards, 
  l.num_loans, 
  l.loan_status, 
  COALESCE(t97.num_trans_1997, 0) AS num_trans_1997,
  COALESCE(t97.money_in_1997, 0) AS money_in_1997,
  COALESCE(t97.money_out_1997, 0) AS money_out_1997,
  COALESCE(t97.peak_balance_1997, 0) AS peak_balance_1997,
  r.peak_balance_rank

  WHERE c.type = 'classic'
),
account_branch AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id as branch_district_id
  FROM account a
),
relevant_account_owner AS (
  SELECT cc.client_id, cc.account_id, ab.branch_district_id
  FROM classic_card_disp cc
  JOIN account_branch ab ON cc.account_id = ab.account_id
),
distinct_owner_per_branch AS (
  -- Get distinct owner per client per branch (a client might own multiple accounts in a branch, count once)
  SELECT branch_district_id, client_id
  FROM relevant_account_owner
  GROUP BY branch_district_id, client_id
),
ext_payments AS (
  -- Outgoing payments by those accounts, where destination is external (bank IS NOT NULL)
  SELECT rao.branch_district_id, t.account_id, t.amount, t.bank, t.account
  FROM relevant_account_owner rao
  JOIN trans t ON rao.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
),
branch_ext_accounts AS (
  -- External accounts per branch: count unique (bank, account)
  SELECT branch_district_id, bank, account
  FROM ext_payments
  GROUP BY branch_district_id, bank, account
),

by_branch AS (
  SELECT 
    d.district_id as branch_district_id,
    d.A2 as district_name,
    COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT dopb.client_id), 0) as num_classic_card_owners,
    COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT bea.bank || '-' || bea.account), 0) as num_external_accounts,
    COALESCE(SUM(ep.amount), 0) as total_outgoing_amount
  FROM district d
  LEFT JOIN distinct_owner_per_branch dopb ON d.district_id = dopb.branch_district_id
  LEFT JOIN branch_ext_accounts bea ON d.district_id = bea.branch_district_id
  LEFT JOIN ext_payments ep ON d.district_id = ep.branch_district_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
)
SELECT 
  district_name,
  num_classic_card_owners,
  num_external_accounts,
  total_outgoing_amount
FROM by_branch
ORDER BY total_outgoing_amount DESC, district_name ASC
LIMIT 1000

WITH molecule_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS num_atoms,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_carbon_atoms,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom a
   GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
bond_stats AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('DOUBLE', 'TRIPLE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_multiple_bonds
    FROM bond b
   GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
carbon_touching_bonds AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id AND a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 AND a2.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C'
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  m.molecule_id,
  m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
  ma.num_atoms,
  COALESCE(bs.num_bonds, 0) AS num_bonds,
  ma.num_carbon_atoms,
  ma.num_chlorine_atoms,
  COALESCE(ctb.num_carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
  COALESCE(bs.num_multiple_bonds, 0) AS num_multiple_bonds,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY COALESCE(ctb.num_carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC, ma.num_atoms DESC, m.molecule_id ASC
  ) AS rank
FROM molecule m
JOIN molecule_atoms ma ON m.molecule_id = ma.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond_stats bs ON m.molecule_id = bs.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN carbon_touching_bonds ctb ON m.molecule_id = ctb.molecule_id
WHERE ma.num_carbon_atoms > 0
ORDER BY rank ASC
LIMIT 1000
